name: tng_3p58m
label: Telescopio Nazionale Galileo 3.58 m
sources: IAC / TNG: 3.58 m Ritchey-Chretien, alt-azimuth, Nasmyth focal length 38.5 m (f/10.75); position: Caporali & Barbieri geodetic GPS survey (28 45 14.4 N, 342 06 39.4 E, 1996-11-22, ~5 m)
notes: Throughput 0.3 (atmosphere + telescope optics to the camera, excl. filter and PDE) is the hbtsim default, not an LPQI number; Prada et al. 2026 (ELTI) adopt an overall instrumental efficiency of 0.5 for a SPAD camera at the focus.
Plate scale 0.13 arcsec per 24.5 um pixel at the Nasmyth focus.
